steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: Roar!!! Roar!!!! Ahhhh!!!! Don't come over, stay away!! Don't want these!! Don't want these!!
It had long lost its cover. Though it's hard to make out its figure, its horrifying sounds rumble loudly across the earth. Wherever it goes, contamination flows like molten lava.
Julien sits in his wheelchair alone, observing the monster from a distance. He came not long after ${PlayerName}'s ceremony ended. The Corpus wasn't hard to find now.

steps.speaker: Old Woman
steps.content: A few days ago, everyone was running around trying to hunt down this poor thing. Now, it's here, and no one cares about it anymore.

steps.speaker: Old Woman
steps.content: The Overgrounders are really strange.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: ...Yeah. Incomprehensible.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: The script was practically identical for both times. It's as if someone tailor-made it for us.

steps.speaker: Old Woman
steps.content: Maybe you just never walked out of that same past. It's quite easy to deal with if you tried.

steps.speaker: Old Woman
steps.content: They always use the same trick to test me.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Was it your doing?

steps.speaker: Old Woman
steps.content: How could it be me? I miss the way it looked when it was first born so much. It was so beautiful, so pure... If I knew it would end up like this, I wouldn't have let it go in the first place.

steps.speaker: Old Woman
steps.content: Look how tragic it is now... To survive, it gorges like a glutton, and is forced to distort. It got so many desires crammed into it and is so bloated from overeating. What a mess. Now, it's even having trouble perpetuating its existence.

steps.speaker: Old Woman
steps.content: Ugh, it's hideous. I'm not interested in it anymore.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Are you from Parma? Or Nirvana?

steps.speaker: Old Woman
steps.content: I'm from the Underground. The person who wiped you out is from Paradeisos.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Really... is that so...

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: I just want to know who arranged such a fate for us. When we were thrown into the Black Ring, what was the expression on their face? Was our wish really that impermissible?

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: In hindsight, it seems... Rustfire and West District are just pawns. Pawns that you use to test each other.

steps.speaker: Old Woman
steps.content: Do you consider yourself unlucky, Overgrounder? Do you feel that fate has treated you unfairly?

steps.speaker: Old Woman
steps.content: Then... let me give you a chance to try.
She gives him a strange crystalline flower. It's red and gives off a faint, ominous glow.

steps.speaker: Old Woman
steps.content: Its consciousness is too chaotic. It needs an anchor to gather everyone. I think you can do it. You're a lot like the people who made it eight years ago.

steps.speaker: Old Woman
steps.content: In any case, I don't want it anymore. You can take it. Let's see what you can do with it.
Julien looks at it for a long time, then stretches out his hand and crushes the flower. Its crystals pierce into his body.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: They're not things for you to pick and choose.
The old woman smiles and walks into a dark alley, where a man in black holds up an umbrella for her respectfully.

steps.speaker: Old Woman
steps.content: If you get the chance to see ${PlayerName} again... say hello for me.
Once again, Julien is alone. He stays there for a long time, then moves the wheelchair in the direction of the roars.
He passes by crumbling walls and ruined neighborhoods. All this destruction was caused by Syndicans themselves.
He gets closer and closer. Voices gradually pour into his mind, burning and stinging him. His senses begin to warp, and a distorted human figure appears before his eyes.

steps.speaker: Distorted Human Figure
steps.content: ...Don't... You shouldn't...
The figure writhes as if it has something to say, but Julien can't hear it clearly. All he feels is irritation. When he passes it, the shadow changes again, but Julien could no longer recognize it.

Everything leaves him behind, like the last bit of reality he experienced and his last clear memory. In the end, he is left only with the despair he's most accustomed to, as well as its corresponding perseverance.
As he gets closer to the target, everything starts to burn. The metal wheelchair melts away in his hands. He can no longer remain sitting. He wants to stand up, but falls to the ground.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Heh... Ha...

steps.speaker: Cacophonous Voice
steps.content: Alright, alright. With those legs of yours, you should just wait up there.

steps.speaker: Cacophonous Voice
steps.content: Just wait for **** to come back. He'll settle everything.

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: The same taste... the same as eight years ago... she looked for you... she chose you...

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: Oh... because... you're very much like them... you're very much like me... long time no see, my... companion...

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: Come... come to me... tell me your wish...

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: I'll make your wish come true...

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Ha... yes... I do resemble them...

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: ...You devoured my companions... and now... you ask me what I wish for...

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: ...Are you able to grant my wish, you spiteful monster? Something like you?
Still not reponding?
No. Be careful. Don't get too close to him. You'll be in big trouble if you get contaminated.
steps.female_content: No. Be careful. Don't get too close to her. You'll be in big trouble if you get contaminated.

steps.content: ...Sigh... It's been a couple of months already. When can...
